title: Kiwi's OptiQoL
description: A lightweight modpack focused entirely on maximum performance and smart Quality-of-Life improvements. The original Vanilla gameplay remains 100% untouched—no gameplay changes, no clutter, just a smoother and better Minecraft experience!
body:
This modpack is 100% Vanilla-compatible

The Ultimate Vanilla+ Experience – Faster. Smoother. Smarter.

This pack is built for players who love the original Minecraft but want modern performance optimizations and essential convenience features. It does not alter core game mechanics, 
adds no custom blocks, and stays completely loyal to the original Vanilla game.What’s Inside:

🚀 Maximum Performance: Massive FPS boosts, optimized RAM usage, 
and faster loading times powered by the best rendering and engine fixes.

🛠️ Smart Quality of Life: Useful interface tweaks and 
comfort features that make inventory management, menus, and controls feel seamless and intuitive.

📦 Bonus Texture Packs: Includes two built-in resource packs to 
improve clarity—one to easily spot dangerous Powder Snow, and another to cleanly hide Bedrock layers.

❌ Zero Gameplay Changes: No new items, bosses, or dimensions. 
You can play on any standard Vanilla server with absolute compatibility.Just install, launch, and enjoy Minecraft smoother than ever before!
